source_title: RGNAU Amethi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 32 Professor, Associate & Assistant Professor Posts (Direct Recruitment)
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 32 (including 13 backlog) · Posts: 3 designation(s) · Type: Central University · Direct Recruitment (failing which by deputation) · Mode: Online · Fee: ₹1000 (Unreserved/OBC-NCL/EWS) / Nil (SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) · Apply: 22 October–22 December 2026 · Salary: Level 14 / 13A / Academic Level 10 · Selection: Screening + Interview · Location: Amethi, Uttar Pradesh
Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU), a Central University under the Ministry of Civil Aviation established by the Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University Act, 2013, has invited online applications for 32 teaching positions including backlog vacancies. The University focuses on aviation sciences, engineering, management, safety and related fields at its headquarters in Fursatganj, Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.
Applications are open on a direct recruitment basis, failing which by deputation, for Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts in Aviation Science, Management or Business Administration, and Engineering and Technology courses. The online portal is https://rgnaurec.samarth.edu.in/ and the closing date is 22 December 2026.
Candidates with the prescribed PhD, Master’s, NET and experience should apply online before the deadline. Foreign nationals other than PIOs and OCIs may apply for fixed-tenure contract posts up to five years, subject to Government of India clearance.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Application once submitted allows no change, correction or modification under any circumstances (clause 26).
In-service candidates must ensure the duly forwarded form with NOC and Vigilance Clearance reaches preferably 10 days before the interview or on the interview date, they may not be allowed to appear (clause 21).
PhD from a foreign university without AIU Equivalence Certificate leads to summary rejection (clause 7).
Incomplete applications are outright rejected; age, experience and qualifications are reckoned as on the closing date (clause 35).

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
Ph.D. in Aviation Science or relevant discipline + 10 publications + 10 years teaching/research (5 at research level) + NET → Professor (Aviation Science Courses) – 2 posts
55% in Master’s in Business Management/Administration or equivalent PGDM or CA/CMA/CS + Ph.D./Fellow + 10 years experience (5 at Level 10) → Professor (Management or Business Administration Courses) – 1 post
Ph.D. with Bachelor’s/Master’s in specified Engineering branches + 10 years experience (5 at Level 10) or industry equivalent → Professor (Engineering and Technology Courses) – 1 post
Ph.D. in Aviation Science or relevant + Master’s 55% + NET + 8 years as Assistant Professor in Level 10 + 5 publications → Associate Professor (Aviation Science Courses) – 6 posts
Master’s 55% or CA/CMA/CS + Ph.D./Fellow + 8 years service → Associate Professor (Management or Business Administration Courses) – 4 posts
Ph.D. with First Class Bachelor’s/Master’s in Engineering branches + 8 years experience or industry route → Associate Professor (Engineering and Technology Courses) – 6 posts
Master’s 55% in Aviation Science or relevant + NET (or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC 2009/2016) → Assistant Professor (Aviation Science Courses) – 6 posts
Master’s 55% or PGDM or CA/CMA/CS + experience and publications → Assistant Professor (Management or Business Administration Courses) – 6 posts
Special quotas (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen) as per UGC/GoI policy; backlog positions marked with * in the vacancy table.
Quick Overview – RGNAU Faculty Recruitment 2026
Organisation: Rajiv Gandhi National Aviation University (RGNAU)
Recruitment / Exam Name: Recruitment of Teaching Positions (including backlog positions)
Notification / Advertisement No.: RGNAU/5360/01/ADMIN/669
Post(s): Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor in Aviation Science, Management or Business Administration, and Engineering and Technology courses
Total Vacancies: 32 (including 13 backlog positions; 3 designations)
Job Location: Fursatganj, Dist. Amethi, Uttar Pradesh (headquarters; various academic units)
Job Type / Nature: Central University · Direct Recruitment (failing which by deputation)
Salary: Professor Level 14 (₹1,44,200–2,18,200); Associate Professor Level 13A (₹1,31,400–2,17,100); Assistant Professor Academic Level 10 (₹57,700–1,82,400) plus allowances as admissible
Apply Between: 22 October 2026 to 22 December 2026
Apply Online: RGNAU Samarth Portal (open until 22 December 2026)
What Posts Are Available? – Post-wise Vacancy & Eligibility
The 32 posts (including 13 backlog-marked *) are grouped by designation and discipline. Associate Professor holds the largest share (16 posts). Category cells are printed as group totals for each pay level, not broken down further by individual discipline.
backlog positions. No further horizontal or per-discipline category cells are printed.
Who Is Eligible for RGNAU Faculty 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: Indian nationals, Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) and/or Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs). Foreign Nationals (other than PIOs and OCIs) are encouraged to apply for faculty positions for fixed tenure not exceeding five years purely on a contract basis, subject to clearance from the Government of India. The notice also states that persons who are not citizens of India shall not be eligible (clause 41); candidates should confirm the applicable reading with the University.
Domicile / local condition: The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition.
Qualifications follow UGC Regulations 2018 as amended. Specialisations listed are indicative but not exhaustive (Aerospace, Aeronautical, Mechanical, Electronics & Communication, Avionics, Computer Science, AI, ML, Data Science for Engineering; relevant Management disciplines).
Professor (Aviation Science): PhD in Aviation Science or relevant discipline and published work of high quality with a minimum of 10 publications as books and/or research or policy papers; Associate Professor with 10 years of teaching and 5 years of research at University/National level, including doctoral guidance; contribution to educational innovation; minimum API score as per UGC 2018; NET qualified. Or an outstanding professional with an established reputation.
Professor (Management/Business Administration): 55% in Master’s in Business Management or Administration or relevant discipline, or 55% in two-year full-time PGDM equivalent by AIU or recognized by AICTE/UGC, or Graduate CA/CMA/CS; Ph.D. or Fellow of IIM or AICTE-recognized equivalent; 10 years teaching/research of which 5 years at Reader/Assistant Professor level in Level 10 (excluding research degree period). Industry route with significant professional work also accepted. Desirable: guiding projects, leadership in academic/research activities.
Professor (Engineering and Technology): PhD with Bachelor’s or Master’s in specified branches (Aerospace/Aeronautical, Mechanical, Electronics & Communication, Avionics, CSE, AI/ML, Data Science etc.); 10 years teaching/research/industry of which at least 5 years at Assistant Professor/Reader level in Level 10. Industry route with Master’s and significant professional work of 10 years (5 at senior level). Desirable: five published works, guiding PG/research projects.
Associate Professor (Aviation Science): PhD in Aviation Science or relevant and NET; Master’s 55%; Assistant Professor in Level 10 with 8 years teaching/research (excluding PhD period) with minimum 5 publications; contribution to innovation and doctoral guidance; minimum API as per UGC 2018.
Associate Professor (Management): Master’s 55% or equivalent PGDM or CA/CMA/CS; Ph.D./Fellow; 8 years service as Assistant Professor or equivalent.
Associate Professor (Engineering): PhD with First Class Bachelor’s/Master’s in specified Engineering branches; 8 years experience or industry equivalent.
Assistant Professor (Aviation Science): 55% at Master’s in Aviation Science or relevant from recognised Indian University or equivalent foreign; cleared NET/SLET/SET by UGC/CSIR or similar; PhD as per UGC 2009 Regulations exempts from NET (with conditions on evaluation, viva, publications, presentations for pre-11 July 2009 registrations).
Assistant Professor (Management): Master’s 55% or PGDM or CA/CMA/CS; relevant experience and at least two papers/publications.
Qualification must be held by: the closing date of submission of the online application (22 December 2026).
Minimum marks: 55% (or equivalent grade) at Master’s level where specified; 5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD as per rules.
What Is the Age Limit? (as on 22 December 2026)
Deputation maximum: Professor and Associate Professor 58 years; Assistant Professor 56 years (as on closing date).
✅ A 49-year-old UR candidate for Professor born on 1 January 1977 — eligible (as on 22 December 2026).
❌ A 51-year-old UR candidate for Professor born on 1 January 1975 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Reservation: Reservations/relaxations policy for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD/EWS as per existing UGC/Govt. of India policy. Backlog positions are included in the totals and marked *. EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives and outcome of any litigation. Appointment is provisional, subject to verification of Income & Asset certificate.
PwBD: Disability not less than 40%. Proof in prescribed Annexure formats must be enclosed; without it the applicant shall not be considered under the PwBD category. PwBD suitability per post is not separately tabulated beyond the general policy.
What Is the Salary? – Pay Scale & Benefits
Pay is as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix plus other allowances as admissible.
Professor: Level 14, ₹1,44,200–2,18,200
Associate Professor: Level 13A, ₹1,31,400–2,17,100
Assistant Professor: Academic Level 10, ₹57,700–1,82,400
Benefits (as printed): Suitable residential accommodation as per allotment rules of RGNAU will be provided in the University Campus on joining. All appointees, including in-service candidates, are governed by the New Pension Scheme (NPS). Age of superannuation as per RGNAU/UGC/Government of India norms. Probation of one year (extendable).
No in-hand estimate is given because the notice does not print DA, HRA or city classification details for calculation.
Payment mode: Online (non-refundable). The online applications processing fee is non-refundable and no enquiries shall be entertained in this regard.
Open the RGNAU Samarth Portal (open until 22 December 2026).
Submit the ONLINE APPLICATION FORM following the instructions given on the portal.
Fill in a correct and active e-mail address; all correspondence will be by e-mail only.
Attach self-attested copies of relevant documents (qualifications, experience, research, publications, category certificates) as required; produce originals at interview if shortlisted.
Pay the application fee if applicable (₹1000 for Unreserved/OBC-NCL/EWS; nil for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen).
Submit before 22 December 2026 and retain the hard-copy printout of the online application along with all certificates for the interview stage.
In-service candidates may submit an advance copy but the duly forwarded application with NOC and Vigilance Clearance must preferably reach the University at least 10 days before the interview or be submitted on the date of interview.
Submitting the form and then trying to correct any detail (no modification is allowed after submission).
Applying without the AIU Equivalence Certificate if the PhD is from a foreign university.
In-service candidates failing to arrange the proper-channel forwarding and Vigilance Clearance in time.
Using an inactive or low-storage e-mail address (all communications, including shortlist and interview schedule, go by e-mail only).
Assuming category certificates in non-prescribed formats will be accepted.
What Can Get Your Application Rejected?

राजिव गांधी राष्ट्रीय विमानन विश्वविद्यालय (RGNAU) ने 32 शिक्षण पदों (बैकलॉग सहित) के लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन आमंत्रित किए हैं। अंतिम तिथि 22 दिसंबर 2026 है। विमानन विज्ञान, प्रबंधन और इंजीनियरिंग विषयों में प्रोफेसर, एसोसिएट प्रोफेसर और असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर के पद हैं।
आवेदन कैसे करें? ऑनलाइन आवेदन https://rgnaurec.samarth.edu.in/ पर 22 दिसंबर 2026 तक जमा करें। फीस ₹1000 (सामान्य/OBC-NCL/EWS) या शून्य (SC/ST/PwBD/भूतपूर्व सैनिक)।
योग्यता क्या है? UGC नियमों के अनुसार पीएचडी, मास्टर डिग्री 55%, NET और अनुभव। उम्र प्रोफेसर 50 वर्ष, एसोसिएट 45 वर्ष, असिस्टेंट 40 वर्ष (प्रत्यक्ष भर्ती)।

Applications are scrutinised as per UGC Regulations 2018 as amended.
Screening Committee shortlists candidates based on academic score (Appendix II Table 3A for universities) and other criteria; the University may restrict the number called for interview.
Shortlisted candidates are called for interview/presentation / other assessment as decided; schedule is emailed.
Selection Committee may recommend a candidate for the next lower post if considered suitable.
Document verification of originals at interview stage.
Final decision of the University / Vice-Chancellor is final.
No interview stage is mentioned as the sole method; screening and shortlisting precede it. No written exam pattern or negative marking is printed. No fixed shortlist ratio is given.
The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Recruitment for You?
This is a regular teaching recruitment at a Central University focused on aviation, offering Level 14 to Academic Level 10 pay with NPS and campus accommodation. Selection rests on UGC academic score screening followed by interview, so strong publications, API and experience matter. Backlog seats exist, but category certificates must match prescribed formats exactly.
Best fit: Candidates with the exact discipline match (aviation science, specified engineering branches or management), required publications and Level-10 experience who can document everything cleanly.
Who should skip: Those whose PhD is from a foreign university without AIU equivalence ready, or in-service applicants who cannot arrange timely NOC and Vigilance Clearance.
Practical tip: Fill the online form only after gathering every certificate in the prescribed format; no correction is allowed after submission.
What makes this recruitment different: It explicitly allows industry-route professionals for several posts and permits foreign nationals on fixed-tenure contract (subject to GoI clearance), while standard direct recruitment follows UGC 2018.

NPS membership and campus accommodation allotment as per rules.
Confirmation after satisfactory probation (not further detailed).

General Instructions & Important Rules
University reserves the right to fill or not fill any or all posts, withdraw the advertisement, or increase/decrease the number of positions.
Qualifications and conditions are subject to UGC / MOCA / MOE norms as amended.
Teaching experience is considered only after fulfilling minimum educational qualification and only at College/University level; guest/visiting faculty does not count for direct recruitment.
No TA/DA or local conveyance is paid except second-class return railway fare for outstation SC/ST candidates on production of tickets.
Representations against ineligible list must reach within 7 days of publication on recruitmentcell@rgnau.ac.in .
Jurisdiction for disputes is the courts in Lucknow.
Character must be suitable; persons dismissed by the Government are ineligible.
IPR of data and deliverables remains with the University.
For query, if any, please write to recruitmentcell@rgnau.ac.in mentioning the name of the post. No separate recruitment phone or helpline is printed in the advertisement. Check RGNAU Careers for updates.
⚠️ Contact details are from the official notification/website. Verify before contacting. Never pay money to anyone offering job assistance. Report fraud at cybercrime.gov.in.
Important Links – RGNAU Faculty 2026
What is the last date to apply for RGNAU Faculty 2026?
22 December 2026. No extension has been announced as of 23 October 2026.
What is the age limit for RGNAU Associate Professor?
45 years for direct recruitment (58 years for deputation). Age is calculated as on 22 December 2026. Relaxation as per GoI/UGC rules for reserved categories is applicable, but the exact years are not printed in the notice.
Is there an exam for RGNAU Associate Professor, or is it interview-based?
Screening as per UGC Regulations 2018 followed by shortlisting on academic score and interview/assessment. No written exam pattern is printed. Negative marking is not mentioned.
What is the salary for Associate Professor posts in this recruitment?
Level 13A of the Pay Matrix, ₹1,31,400–2,17,100 plus other allowances as admissible. NPS applies. No in-hand figure is printed.
Can final-year students apply for this recruitment?
No — the qualifications (PhD, Master’s with required marks, NET where applicable, and experience) must be held by the closing date of 22 December 2026.
Is this Associate Professor post a permanent government job?
The notice advertises the posts on direct recruitment (failing which by deputation). Direct recruits are on probation for one year. The posts are under a Central University and governed by NPS; the notice does not use the word “permanent” for the status.
Can candidates from other states apply?
Yes — the notice does not state a domicile or residence condition.
Where will selected candidates be posted?
At the University’s headquarters in Fursatganj, Dist. Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, and its various academic units. Suitable campus accommodation is provided on joining as per allotment rules.
What is the application fee for RGNAU Faculty Recruitment 2026?
₹1000 for Unreserved/OBC-NCL/EWS (non-refundable). Exempted for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-Servicemen.
Does the notice allow industry professionals to apply?
Yes — for several Professor and Associate Professor posts, an industry/profession route with significant professional work and specified experience is accepted in addition to the academic route.
